_note: 英文覆盖表（docs/游戏英文版方案.md §3.2）：只放「给人看」的字段，按 id 与 games.json 字段级合并，缺字段/缺条目落回中文（决策③）；机制字段（mode/entry/saveMode/saveKeys/gamepad*/orientation/version/tier）以中文母本为准，这里出现即为错误。

huapao-2048.title: Firecracker Merge
huapao-2048.tagline: A fireworks-workshop take on 2048: merge from paper fuses and gunpowder all the way to the Kiss of Flames, and slide out big blooms.

catch-fireworks.title: Firework Catch
catch-fireworks.tagline: Fireworks burst overhead and fall one by one — steady your bowl and catch them; drop three and the show ends.

hextris.title: Hextris
hextris.tagline: Spin the hexagon and catch falling blocks on matching sides — three of a color chain-burst. Fast hands and a cool head, both required.

tetris.title: Falling Blocks
tetris.tagline: The classic falling-block formula: clear full lines, watch the speed climb — how deep can you go?
tetris.controls: Arrows to move · Space to hard-drop (gamepad works)

jump.title: Jump Jump
jump.tagline: Hold to charge, release to hop onto the next block — the truer the landing, the higher the score. A classic micro-precision game rebuilt with Three.js.
jump.controls: Hold (touch/mouse) to charge · release to jump

pacman.title: Pac-Man
pacman.tagline: The arcade-era icon: munch every dot, dodge four ghosts with distinct personalities — AI pathfinding recreates the pincer pressure.
pacman.controls: Arrow keys · Space to pause (gamepad works)

battle-city.title: Battle City
battle-city.tagline: A faithful remake of the NES classic: defend your base, wipe out the enemy tanks — a 35-stage campaign, a level editor and same-screen co-op.
battle-city.controls: P1: WASD move · J fire (gamepad = P1) | P2: arrows · K fire

win12.title: Windows 12 web edition
win12.tagline: A whole "PC" running in your browser: desktop, windows, built-in apps and easter eggs — free to explore, no ending.
win12.deviceNote: Full local mirror: login on boot, Chinese/English plus many more interface languages, theme library, AI assistant, lunar calendar and weather widgets all available (the original online version was retired after an antivirus false-positive)

pvz.title: Plants vs. Zombies
pvz.tagline: The classic lawn defense across five lanes: sunflowers bank sun, peashooters do the damage, wall-nuts take the hits — survive wave after wave of the night raid.
pvz.controls: Mouse to plant / collect sun (keyboard & mouse required)
pvz.deviceNote: Chinese interface. First load is about 65 MB — Wi-Fi or desktop recommended; progress autosaves in this browser, with in-game export

minecraft-1.8.title: Minecraft 1.8 (web)
minecraft-1.8.tagline: The 1.8 block sandbox, playable straight in the browser: infinite terrain, switch between survival and creative freely, open your world on LAN and play with friends.
minecraft-1.8.controls: Keyboard & mouse: WASD move · mouse look/mine/place · E inventory
minecraft-1.8.deviceNote: Needs a recent browser and plenty of memory — iOS is risky; first load about 15 MB; worlds are saved in this browser

minecraft-1.12.title: Minecraft 1.12.2 (web)
minecraft-1.12.tagline: The 1.12.2 block sandbox on the web: more blocks and mobs, enchanting and achievements fully evolved — LAN co-op works here too.
minecraft-1.12.controls: Keyboard & mouse: WASD move · mouse look/mine/place · E inventory
minecraft-1.12.deviceNote: Needs a recent browser and plenty of memory — iOS is risky; first load about 20 MB; worlds are saved in this browser

4399-230326.title: Bleach vs. Naruto: Bond
4399-230326.tagline: Bleach and Naruto characters clash in same-screen brawls: combos, supers and assist strikes — 4399's official H5 port of the flash-era fighter.
4399-230326.deviceNote: Chinese interface. First load is about 45 MB — desktop or Wi-Fi recommended.

4399-231124.title: Pet Connect 3.1
4399-231124.tagline: H5 revival of 4399's evergreen connect-the-pairs classic: clear matching pet tiles against the clock — paths may turn at most twice.

4399-246749.title: Escape Room 3: Office Tower
4399-246749.tagline: Third entry in the classic escape series: trapped in an office building — search for items, crack the mechanisms, and claw your way out floor by floor.

4399-257780.title: AI Gomoku
4399-257780.tagline: A quiet board game against a local AI: no network, no sign-in — Minimax attack and defense, one tap to start.
4399-257780.controls: Tap / click to place a stone

4399-226392.title: IQ Sudoku
4399-226392.tagline: A crisp sudoku by WellSudoku: four difficulties, pencil notes, mistake hints — the pure deduction of pen and paper.

chinese-chess.title: Chinese Chess
chinese-chess.tagline: Red versus black across the river: an opening-book AI with two strength levels, undo and a bigger board — tap to play.
chinese-chess.deviceNote: The mid-level AI thinks locally and may pause for 1–3 seconds before moving.

cloud-netease.title: NetEase Cloud Gaming
cloud-netease.tagline: NetEase's official platform — cloud PC / cloud phone, NetEase titles without downloads

cloud-taptap.title: TapTap Cloud Gaming
cloud-taptap.tagline: TapTap's web cloud-play zone — mobile games, tap and play

cloud-migu.title: Migu Gaming
cloud-migu.tagline: China Mobile's cloud gaming service — PC web portal

cloud-tencent.title: Tencent Cloud Gaming
cloud-tencent.tagline: Tencent's official cloud gaming platform — play new titles first (mostly mobile games)

cloud-start.title: START Cloud Gaming
cloud-start.tagline: Tencent's official cloud gaming for PC titles — big games launch instantly, no download
cloud-start.note: Sign-in required · keyboard & mouse recommended · mainland China service

cloud-mihoyo.title: HoYoverse Cloud Gaming
cloud-mihoyo.tagline: HoYoverse's official cloud gaming — Genshin Impact and other big titles, tap and play, no download
cloud-mihoyo.note: Sign-in required · limited free time · mainland China service
